question: Which of the following is/are a gymnosperm?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cycas**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cycas** is a type of gymnosperm.
 
• Gymnosperms are seed-producing plants that do not form flowers or fruits. Instead, their seeds are exposed or "naked," typically on cones.
 
• Other examples of gymnosperms include conifers, ginkgo, and gnetophytes.</li&
